_readme: FIAT OUTSTANDING ART (19 Oct, Matt): the Map's other three zones and nine sites; the order's three heads - a face, the fight's three poses, their place for the order card, their unique. After the test reads.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_outstanding_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list; ++ --only <name> ++ --force to reroll). Regenerate with python3 tools/make_outstanding_manifest.py.

jobs.description: Pixel art, seen straight down from directly above like an aerial photograph turned into a painted map: a 1960s council estate and its high street: rows of terraced roofs, three grey tower blocks' flat roofs, car parks, a parade of shop roofs, a retail park's big flat sheds and their car park, scrubby greens between. The whole frame filled edge to edge with ground, no horizon, no sky, no border, no frame, no vignette. Muted blue-grey and slate palette with slate greys, dusk light, a few warm orange lights; quiet and empty, no people, no vehicles moving, no text, no labels, no readable signs or numbers. Even detail all over: the picture is cut to an irregular shape and drawn under markers, so nothing in it should be the only thing worth looking at.
jobs._where: the Map: The Estate's ground, clipped to its shape (box (0, 170, 420, 560) in the 1000 x 844 drawing, drawn x2)
